Check a Generated Parameter Function Against a NONMEM Table

verifyParamFunction.Rd

Evaluates the function generated by createParamFunction() over the rows of a NONMEM $TABLE file and compares the result with the values NONMEM itself wrote. This turns "do I trust the translation?" into a pass/fail check per parameter.

Usage

verifyParamFunction(
  x,
  tabFile,
  thetas,
  fun = NULL,
  parameters = NULL,
  tol = 1e-04,
  idVar = "ID",
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

The list returned by createParamFunction().

tabFile

Path to a NONMEM table file (an sdtab / patab / xptab). The first line is the TABLE NO. banner and the second the column header.

thetas

A numeric vector of THETA values, normally the final estimates, e.g. as.numeric(getExt(extFile)[getExt(extFile)$ITERATION == -1000000000, 2:15]).

fun

The function to check. Defaults to the one in x$code; supply it explicitly if you have edited the generated source.

parameters

A character vector of parameters to check. Defaults to the $PK parameters (x$primaryNames, or x$functionListName for an older object); secondary parameters are skipped, since a secondary quantity is generally not a table column and not reducible to a typical value. Name one explicitly here to check it anyway.

tol

Relative tolerance for a pass. Defaults to 1e-4.

idVar

Column identifying subjects, used only to report how many subjects were covered. Defaults to "ID".

quiet

Logical. If FALSE (default), reports the outcome per parameter.

Value

A single logical - TRUE only if every requested parameter was checked and passed within tol - so the result can be used directly in an if. A parameter that could not be reconciled against the table (PASS = NA) makes the result FALSE. The per-parameter table is attached as attr(x, "checks"): a data frame with PARAMETER, TABLECOLUMN, N, MAXABSDIFF, MAXRELDIFF and PASS, itself carrying the per-row values in its "detail" attribute. Printing shows the table.

Details

Why the table rather than the input data. $TABLE output is written after IGNORE and ACCEPT have been applied, so a table row always corresponds to a record the model actually used. Taking the covariates from the same file as the parameters therefore removes any need to reproduce the $DATA filtering, and removes the risk of comparing misaligned rows. Add the covariates and the parameters to your $TABLE and no filtering logic is needed here at all.

Typical versus individual values. A generated function returns typical values, but NONMEM tables individual ones. Where a parameter is written P = <expr> * EXP(ETA(n)) in $PK, createParamFunction() records the ETA index in its etaMap, and this function divides the tabled value by exp(ETA(n)) to recover the typical value - so the ETA column must also be in the table. A column named TVP is used directly when present and needs no ETA. Parameters that can be reconciled in neither way are reported with PASS = NA and a warning rather than being silently compared.

Tolerance. NONMEM's default table format carries about five significant digits, so agreement closer than roughly 1e-5 relative cannot be observed. The default tol of 1e-4 sits just above that floor.

Anything missing from the table produces a loud warning and a row with PASS = NA; the function still returns a report for the parameters it could check.

See also

createParamFunction() vignette("Part3-deep-dive-forest-plot-inputs", package = "PMXForest") for how this fits the whole workflow.

Examples

modFile <- system.file("extdata", "SimVal/run7.mod", package = "PMXForest")
out <- createParamFunction(modFile, parameters = c("CL", "V"), quiet = TRUE)
#> Warning: The reference value for GENO4, GENO1, GENO3 was inferred rather than read from the control stream. Check the preamble of the generated function and override through covRef if it is wrong.

## `out$etaMap` records that CL and V carry exponential IIV, so a table
## holding CL, V, ETA3, ETA4 and the covariates can be reconciled directly:
out$etaMap
#> CL  V 
#>  3  4 

## if (verifyParamFunction(out, tabFile = "xptab7", thetas = thetas))
##   message("generated function reproduces the table")
##
## v <- verifyParamFunction(out, tabFile = "xptab7", thetas = thetas)
## attr(v, "checks")          # per-parameter detail
